parameters.query:
SELECT 
  b.open_time, b.close_time,
  b.lunch_start_time, b.lunch_duration,
  b.break1_time, b.break1_duration,
  b.break2_time, b.break2_duration,
  b.break3_time, b.break3_duration,
  b.close_time_weekend,
  b.open_time_weekend,
  b.service_days,
  w.id AS workshop_id,
  w.google_calendar_url AS calendar_id
FROM branches b
JOIN workshops w ON w.branch_id = b.id 
  AND w.is_active = true 
  AND w.google_calendar_url IS NOT NULL 
  AND w.google_calendar_url != ''
WHERE b.id = {{ $('Validate Input').first().json.branch_id }}
  AND b.client_id = {{ $('Validate Input').first().json.client_id }}
  AND b.is_active = true

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, available_slots: [], no_calendar: true, reason: $('Prepare Availability Check').first().json.reason || 'no_workshops' }) }}
